cpu: AOT release; no application process ran concurrently with another benchmark or our build/test jobs
scroll: 200 active frames per position; 40 warmup frames; 2 alternating baseline/candidate runs; initial full layout excluded; real ScrollView, Text/RichText and TuiFrameLoop; no transport/ANSI or terminal display
samples: 600 frames per mode, 30 warmup and 30 initialization frames; two alternating runs; clean frames forced; leaf mutates one visibly changing RenderText; full dirties every render object
heap: JIT deterministic VM; 300 warmup and 400 active visible-leaf frames; explicit GC before and after; Fleury-class shallow live bytes only; excludes SDK strings/lists and external storage; not cumulative allocation, RSS, peak or universal memory proof
hostReview: All retained measurements were refreshed using identical SampleFrameHost code with pointer/focus begin, end and abort transactions matching TuiRuntime. A failure/recovery regression passes.
selectedScroll: Same active scrolling protocol, select-all verified before timing; baseline already includes row culling. 100 and 1000 lines; two alternating runs; 200 frames per position. Do not multiply this ratio by the merged-main ratio.
highlightHeap: Same 1000-line document selected in an 80x24 viewport; 300 warmup and 400 forced unchanged paints, explicit GC before/after; two fresh processes each per side. Baseline already includes the selection-range optimization. Fleury-class shallow live bytes, not total RAM.
